Alex — thanks for the detailed review. We discussed internally with legal and finance and prepared a focused counterproposal to keep this moving. Summary of the changes in the counterproposal (attached and linked):

- Term: propose 18 months (compromise between your 12 and our standard 24). Include a performance review at month 6 with a one‑time option to convert to a 24‑month price schedule if mutually agreed.
- Uplift/true‑up: accept usage true‑up for months 7–12 but keep a modest baseline guarantee (10% of uplifted capacity) to secure slot allocation. True‑up formula is in Section 2 of the counterproposal.
- Audit retention: agree to 13 months for audit event logs (we will scope which events are included).
- Indemnity: we cannot fully remove the cap. We can carve out willful misconduct with an express monetary floor tied to the size of the claim; legal proposed language attached.

We also proposed a one‑month pilot credit (applied in month 1) and a staggered billing schedule to align with your procurement PO timing. Attached is the annotated counterproposal (DataForge_Counterproposal_annotated.pdf) and the editable track‑changes doc (RF_Counterproposal_v1.docx).
